meta.title: Catalogus Codicum Astrologorum Graecorum (CCAG): merged inventory of edited texts
meta.basis: Landscape survey + inventories and adversarial verification of groups g1-g8 (all 20 parts)
meta.merge_rule: One record per text; the same text edited in several volumes is merged with all references. Large works already translated (Valens, Hephaestion, Rhetorius, Antiochus, Paul, Julian, Serapio, Dorotheus, Palchus chapters, Secrets of Apomasar, Anonymous of 379, Teucer) are each merged into one record. Small items of one manuscript proposed as one unit by the verifiers are merged (components listed in the title).

verdicts.strong: verified candidate (provisional where the verifier could not search the web)
verdicts.possible: usable with caveats (bundle, Russian-first only, a check outstanding, or rights)
verdicts.drop: already translated, superseded or too small
verdicts.excluded: not a candidate per inventory (translated, superseded, not Greek); not re-checked

caveats: Web-search budget was exhausted during verification: 'none found' means not found in the sources checked (HOROI 450 titles and teasers, Hindsight summaries, landscape Russian searches, direct reads), not proven absence.

An unreviewed machine English translation of all 20 parts exists (archive.org item vol.-8-part-3-1912-codicum-parisinorum-dual-language, 2026); Source Library (vols I, VII) and Scriptorai (vol. I) also. Claims must read 'first Russian translation' or 'first reviewed scholarly translation'.
Rights summaries are orientation, not legal advice.
